conclusion: Zero of the 28 residual disagreements is a confirmed extraction error. Every one is an artefact of what the AUDIT can see: 12 sentences attribute the abundance to the control group (so the graph's 'depleted in disease' is correct and the raw cue is the inverted one), 9 compare something other than disease vs healthy control (treatment arms, timepoints, symptom or converter subgroups, a regression on a continuous score), 4 carry a direction belonging to a different taxon, 2 are background that leaked past the provenance filter, and 1 is truncated. So 86.6% is a LOWER BOUND on reading fidelity, not an estimate of it.
